correctness.rationale: Exact occupancy equivalence \(r_i+c_j\le2\) on selected squares plus full-row/full-column domination condition. Exhaustive derivation of four omission-pattern families and disjoint binomial counts; maximum omitted squares yields minimum formula. Independent direct-graph exhaustive verifier checked all 35,717,120 subsets over \(4\times4\), \(4\times5\), \(5\times4\), \(5\times5\), including classification and all polynomial coefficients. Computation corroborates, does not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete all-cardinality two-limited domination polynomial for a natural infinite Cartesian-product graph family, with full pattern structure and minimizer counts, substantially refines special previously known minima and differs from ordinary rook polynomial. Useful for capacity-constrained domination and enumerative graph polynomials; this precise statistic is not implied by published special-case minimum.
